Increment 2: Admin dashboard and resident records
Increment 3: Notifications, payments, and staff access rules
Reviewed by the Barangay Secretary and the Asst. VAWC Desk Officer
Increment 4: GIS-based Community Issue Map and waste management

Modules are not released one at a time: the complete website is tested and deployed once.
